+# This file is part of Ansible

+# Ansible is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
+# it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
+# the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or

+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+from units.compat.mock import Mock, patch
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux import LinuxNetwork, LinuxNetworkCollector
+
+
+class TestLinuxLocallyReachableIPs(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.module = Mock()
+        self.network = LinuxNetwork(self.module)
+
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True)
+    def test_local_routes_are_normalized_and_ordered(self):
+        routes = {
+            '-4': '''local 192.168.1.9/24 dev lo scope host
+local 192.168.0.1 dev lo scope host
+local 127.0.0.1/32 dev lo scope host
+local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo scope host
+local 192.168.1.0/24 dev lo scope host
+broadcast 192.168.1.255 dev eth0 scope link
+local 10.0.0.1 dev lo scope link
+''',
+            '-6': '''local 2001:db8::2/64 dev lo
+local ::1 dev lo proto kernel
+local 2001:db8::/64 dev lo scope host
+local bad-address dev lo scope host
+''',
+        }
+        self.module.run_command.side_effect = lambda args, **kwargs: (0, routes[args[1]], '')
+
+        self.assertEqual(self.network.get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip'), {
+            'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8', '127.0.0.1', '192.168.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24'],
+            'ipv6': ['::1', '2001:db8::/64'],
+        })
+        self.assertEqual(self.module.run_command.call_count, 2)
+        self.module.run_command.assert_any_call(
+            ['/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local'], errors='surrogate_then_replace')
+
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True)
+    def test_failed_family_does_not_discard_other_family(self):
+        self.module.run_command.side_effect = [(1, '', 'unsupported'), (0, 'local ::1 dev lo\n', '')]
+        self.assertEqual(self.network.get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip'), {
+            'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': ['::1'],
+        })
+        self.module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to gather locally reachable ipv4 routes')
+
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', False)
+    def test_no_ipv6_support(self):
+        self.module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host\n', '')
+        self.assertEqual(self.network.get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip'), {
+            'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': [],
+        })
+        self.module.run_command.assert_called_once()
+
+    def test_populate_exposes_fact(self):
+        self.module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/ip'
+        self.network.get_default_interfaces = Mock(return_value=({}, {}))
+        self.network.get_interfaces_info = Mock(return_value=({}, {
+            'all_ipv4_addresses': [], 'all_ipv6_addresses': [],
+        }))
+        self.network.get_locally_reachable_ips = Mock(return_value={'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': []})
+
+        facts = self.network.populate()
+        self.assertEqual(facts['locally_reachable_ips'], {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': []})
+        self.assertIn('locally_reachable_ips', LinuxNetworkCollector._fact_ids)
+
+    def test_missing_ip_command(self):
+        self.module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+        self.assertEqual(self.network.populate(), {'locally_reachable_ips': {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}})
+        self.module.warn.assert_called_once()
